name: 22030 · Fairfax, VA
findings: ZIP 22030 (Fairfax) has 424 nonprofit organizations. 235 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 202 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22030 (Fairfax) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22030 (Fairfax) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 202 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
